title: Comments
description: Track and manage all comments from your connected pages. Set up a Post Reply on any post to auto-reply to commenters who use a keyword.
author: Author
emptyNeedsActionSub: Great work! All comments from your pages have been replied to.
emptyAllSub: Reply to comments from Facebook and Instagram in one place.
emptyAutoRepliedSub: Comments handled by Smart Reply will appear here once auto-reply is active.
emptyHandledSub: Comments you mark as handled will appear here.
noCommentsDesc: Comments from your Facebook and Instagram pages will appear here.
noCommentsForFilter: No comments match this filter. Try another filter or wait for new comments.

postTriggerDescription: A Post Reply is a ready-made message you write yourself, sent as-is when someone comments your keyword on this post.
postTriggerDeliveryPublic: Based on your settings, this reply will be posted as a public comment on the post.
postTriggerDeliveryPrivate: Based on your settings, this reply will be sent to the commenter in a private message.
postTriggerDeliveryDual: Based on your settings, this reply will be sent in a private message, with a short public comment posted on the post.
postTriggerKeywordPlaceholder: Type a keyword and press Enter
postTriggerKeywordHelp: Add up to 10 keywords like price or location — any match triggers the reply
postTriggerReplyPlaceholder: Message to send when a comment matches a keyword...
postTriggerAllCaution: Everyone who comments gets this same reply — best for giveaways and 'comment for the link' posts. Spam and friend-tags are skipped automatically.
postTriggerAllReplyPlaceholder: Message to send to anyone who comments...
postTriggerOutcomeAsWritten: The exact text you wrote above
postTriggerAria: Set up Post Reply for this post
postTriggerActiveAria: Post reply active on this post
postTriggerClearConfirmMessage: Comments matching the keyword will no longer trigger an automatic reply on this post.
postTriggerImageDmOnly: Sent in the private message with your reply
postTriggerLikeCommentDesc: Your page likes the comment when the reply is sent. Facebook only.
postTriggerReadMoreNote: After the customer taps «Read more», your full reply arrives in the chat.
postTriggerImageTapHint: The customer can tap the image to open it full-size.
postTriggerImageBadType: Unsupported image type. Use JPG, PNG, or WEBP.
postTriggerImageQuota: Your store's image storage is full. Deleted posts' images are cleaned up automatically — upgrade your plan for more space.
postTriggerImageLockedHint: Images are available in private-message mode
postReplyIntroText: Set keywords on any post, and your ready-made message is sent as-is when someone comments them — great for replies you send often.
